text.title: Java Spring Boot Enterprise Patterns Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema for the enterprise-service manifest this methodology produces. Validator enforces required keys + per-field constraints. The `configuration` block covers the configuration-binding rules merged in under the `config-` prefix.

section.title: Schema

example.code: { "spring_boot_version": "3.2.1", "base_entity": {"pk_type": "UUID", "has_audit": true, "has_version": true}, "uses_record_dtos": true, "uses_mapstruct": true, "service_readonly_default": true, "search_strategy": "JpaSpecificationExecutor", "uses_problemdetail_advice": true, "actuator_enabled": true, "configuration": { "properties_classes": ["MailProperties", "AuthProperties"], "validated_properties": true, "system_getenv_count": 0, "max_value_annotations_per_bean": 2, "runtime_env_branches": 0, "profiles": ["dev", "staging", "prod"] }, "forbidden_patterns_found": [] }

{ "spring_boot_version": "2.7.0", "base_entity": {"pk_type": "Long", "has_audit": false, "has_version": false}, "uses_record_dtos": false, "uses_mapstruct": false, "service_readonly_default": false, "search_strategy": "JpqlConcat", "uses_problemdetail_advice": false, "actuator_enabled": false, "configuration": { "properties_classes": [], "validated_properties": false, "system_getenv_count": 5, "max_value_annotations_per_bean": 12, "runtime_env_branches": 3, "profiles": ["dev"] }, "forbidden_patterns_found": ["@Data on entity in BaseUser"] }
example.note: Boot 2.x; sequential Long PK; missing audit + version; class DTOs; service has no readOnly default; JPQL concat for search; ProblemDetail off; Actuator off; no @ConfigurationProperties classes; unvalidated config; five System.getenv reads; twelve @Value annotations in one bean; runtime env branches; only one profile.

list.item: Sequential `Long` primary key for externally-exposed resources.
Actuator on classpath without security on non-`/health` endpoints.
More than three `@Value` annotations on a single bean.
`@ConfigurationProperties` type without `@Validated`, or with an unconstrained field.
An error response carrying a stack trace.
